summary: Explains ini (lowercase collection-prefixed section and key), vars (lowercase prefixed, following variable precedence, last listed wins), and secret (since 2.22, masks the value in output; only str/string/list types, not suboptions).
questions: How do I let users set a plugin option in ansible.cfg?
How do I mark a plugin option as a secret so it's masked?
Can I use secret on a suboption?
How do Ansible variables set plugin options?

answer_card.title: ini, vars and secret plugin settings
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ini`: `section` + `key`, lowercase and collection-prefixed; lets `ansible.cfg` set it.
- `vars`: lowercase prefixed variable names; follow variable precedence; last listed wins.
- `secret: true` (**2.22+**): resolved value is registered and masked in output. Only for `str`, `string` and `list` of strings; not on suboptions.
